payload.title: The plan line cannot be cut from main while design/first-share conflicts with it
payload.body: THE LOOP (6) puts the integration line at plan/<plan>, a branch cut from main when the plan is bound. Cut from main (2288b948) and merged with design-shard (82de7562), the combination conflicts in packages/canon/src/agents/mav.ts: main carries a cherry-pick of 'mav's description names the architect it is' that design/first-share holds in a different form. The conflict is in history from before the plan was bound, not in any unit, so a red on it would name no owner. The integrator cut plan/corrected-shards at the binding commit 151f415b on design/first-share instead and combines achieved units there; a unit whose parent commit is not yet achieved is cherry-picked alone. Releasing the line to main will meet the same mav.ts conflict; the operator resolves it at release.
